coverage_law.statement: Wave 30 located the vocabulary review cliff exactly at the 0.81 token-coverage crossing (ARCH.V9 0.81402 -> 9/15, ARCH.V8 0.80049 -> 4/15) and proposed it as a GPU-free gate on vocabulary K.
coverage_law.what_it_predicts: Both new rungs clear the 0.81 crossing by nine to eleven points, so the coverage gate is NOT binding anywhere on this probe and it predicts no emission-side collapse at either K.  It does not predict a GAIN: coverage is monotone in K and the sealed solo ladder is not (V32 0.940 -> 11/15, V22 0.915 -> 13/15, V19 0.906 -> 14/15).  So L4 is a test of whether the composed child follows COVERAGE or follows the SOLO LADDER, and the two disagree in sign at these two rungs.
coverage_law.falsifier: If V24CL1792 or V26CL1792 reads at or above ARCH.V19CL1792's 7/15, more rows bought cases on the composed child and the solo ladder's summit does not transfer through composition.  If both read below 7, the summit transfers and coverage above the crossing buys nothing.

standing_caution: Wave 30's allocator was 2.14 cases optimistic at 0.65x and 5.68 cases optimistic at 0.55x, where it carried its own EXTRAPOLATES-INTO-THE-GAP flag.  Every mlp prediction in this file carries that flag, because 1664, 1536 and 1408 all sit inside the interval the flag names.  The fit's MAE is 2.126 cases and its worst residual is larger; a one-case agreement between prediction and observation here is not a confirmation of anything.
